[[Leah Stone]] was a [[Chosen]] from [[Loamhurst]] who was killed by the [[White Mantle]] on one of the [[Bloodstone]]s. Her spirit was trapped near the volcano [[Abaddon's Mouth]] and the dark magics of the island have drained her soul's energy. The [[bonus]] objective of the Abaddon's Mouth mission is to fulfill her final wish by escorting her safely to a [[Leah's island|small grassy island]] near the coast to the west, which has a single tree that reminds her of Loamhurst.

== Missions ==
* [[Ring of Fire Islands]]
** {{NPC location|Abaddon's Mouth}}

== Dialogue ==
:''"This place is slowly draining my soul's remaining energy. We must hurry. I will not last long."''

== Notes ==
* She walks faster while in the fortress, but once outside, her speed decreases noticeably.
** She will stop entirely unless she is within compass range of at least one player.
** To speed her progress, you can use any speed boost that affect allies, e.g. [["Fall Back!"]].
* She is affected by [[lava]] for only one second (instead of the expected three), implying she has [[Natural Resistance]] or similar protection.
